transcript.text:
Here is the full sequence of API calls, including authentication.

---

## 1. Authenticate — Get an Access Token

For a script or automation, use the **Client Credentials** grant with a Personal Access Token (PAT).

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={clientId}
&client_secret={clientSecret}
```

Store the returned `access_token` and pass it as `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on every subsequent call.

---

## 2. Create the Campaign

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Q3 Access Review",
  "description": "Quarterly manager certification of user access",
  "type": "MANAGER",
  "deadlineDuration": "P14D"
}
```

- For a **Manager Campaign**, `type` = `MANAGER` and no search query is required.
- For an **Identity** or **Access Items** campaign, you'd also supply a `filter` / search query body.
- The response returns the campaign object including its `id`.

---

## 3. (Optional) Get Campaign to Review It Before Activating

```bash
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Lets you confirm the generated campaign looks correct before activating it.

---

## 4. Activate the Campaign

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/activate
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

This moves the campaign from preview/draft into active status, making it visible to reviewers.

---

## 5. Pull Results / Reports

Once the campaign is active and reviewers are working through it, retrieve reports:

```bash
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/reports
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

If you want to trigger a fresh report generation first:

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{campaignId}/reports/{reportType}
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Where `{reportType}` is something like `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION` or `DECISIONS_SUMMARY`.

---

### Summary of the flow

| Step | Method | Path |
|------|--------|------|
| Auth | POST | `/oauth/token` |
| Create campaign | POST | `/v3/campaigns` |
| Inspect campaign | GET | `/v3/campaigns/{id}` |
| Activate campaign | POST | `/v3/campaigns/{id}/activate` |
| Get reports | GET | `/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports` |
